title: Batch Job Controller
subtitle: Runs a large job on a local card or a rented one, pauses, scales or stops it mid-flight, turns a one-off job into an always-on service, and isolates a job that misbehaves.
lede: Runs a large job on a local card or a rented one, pauses, scales or stops it mid-flight, turns a one-off job into an always-on service, and isolates a job that misbehaves. Every control action is kept on record for review.
who: A data engineering lead running long jobs
author: Corey James
